description: This file defines the LocationService interface in the OpenMRS API, specifying methods for managing locations, location tags, attribute types, and related entities within the system. It includes operations for creating, retrieving, updating, retiring, and deleting locations and tags, as well as managing address templates and location attribute types.

methods.name: setLocationDAO
methods.description: Sets the data access object for location data interactions.

methods.name: saveLocation
methods.description: Saves or updates a Location object in the database.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a Location by its primary key (ID) or by name.

methods.name: getDefaultLocation
methods.description: Returns the default Location.

methods.name: getLocationByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Location by its UUID.

methods.name: getLocationTagByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationTag by its UUID.

methods.name: getAllLocations
methods.description: Returns all locations, including retired ones.

methods.name: getAllLocations (with includeRetired parameter)
methods.description: Returns all locations filtered by whether retired locations are included.

methods.name: getLocations
methods.description: Searches locations by name fragment.

methods.name: getLocations (with filters)
methods.description: Retrieves locations based on multiple search criteria including parent location, attributes, and retirement status.

methods.name: getLocationsByTag
methods.description: Finds locations that contain a specific tag.

methods.name: getLocationsHavingAllTags
methods.description: Finds locations that have all specified tags.

methods.name: getLocationsHavingAnyTag
methods.description: Finds locations that have any of the specified tags.

methods.name: retireLocation
methods.description: Retires a Location from circulation.

methods.name: unretireLocation
methods.description: Unretires a previously retired Location.

methods.name: purgeLocation
methods.description: Permanently deletes a Location from the database.

methods.name: saveLocationTag
methods.description: Creates or updates a LocationTag.

methods.name: getLocationTag
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationTag by its primary key.

methods.name: getLocationTagByName
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationTag by its exact name.

methods.name: getAllLocationTags
methods.description: Returns all location tags, including retired ones.

methods.name: getAllLocationTags (with includeRetired)
methods.description: Returns all location tags filtered by retirement status.

methods.name: getLocationTags
methods.description: Finds location tags matching a search string.

methods.name: retireLocationTag
methods.description: Retires a LocationTag.

methods.name: unretireLocationTag
methods.description: Unretires a LocationTag.

methods.name: purgeLocationTag
methods.description: Permanently deletes a LocationTag.

methods.name: getCountOfLocations
methods.description: Counts locations starting with a specified name fragment.

methods.name: getRootLocations
methods.description: Returns all root locations (without a parent).

methods.name: getPossibleAddressValues
methods.description: Provides possible address values for a given address field, typically overridden.

methods.name: getAddressTemplate
methods.description: Returns the XML string of the default address template.

methods.name: saveAddressTemplate
methods.description: Saves the address template XML to global properties.

methods.name: getAllLocationAttributeTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all location attribute types, including retired ones.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves a location attribute type by its internal ID.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a location attribute type by its UUID.

methods.name: saveLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Creates or updates a LocationAttributeType.

methods.name: retireLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Retires a LocationAttributeType.

methods.name: unretireLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Unretires a LocationAttributeType.

methods.name: purgeLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes a LocationAttributeType from the database.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationAttribute by UUID.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeTypeByName
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationAttributeType by name.
